items.title: Dependency cache design
items.text: Cache rebuildable dependencies using a key that includes the package manager, runtime/OS as appropriate, and lockfile hash. A cache miss must not change build correctness, and secrets do not belong in caches.

content_blocks.code:
name: Cache Python dependencies
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
content_blocks.expected_output: The setup action derives its cache key from the dependency file; when `requirements.txt` changes, dependencies are restored or rebuilt for the new key.
content_blocks.run_instructions: Use a repository with the stated requirements file and measure warm versus cold workflow time.
content_blocks.reset_steps: Do not cache virtual environments containing credentials or rely on cache contents as the sole source of correctness.
